examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{家|いえ}の{裏|うら}には{大|おお}きな{鶏|にわとり}{小屋|ごや}があって、{毎朝|まいあさ}{新鮮|しんせん}な{卵|たまご}を{集|あつ}めるのが{子|こ}どもたちの{楽|たの}しみだった。
examples.english: Behind my grandfather's house there was a large chicken coop, and collecting fresh eggs every morning was the children's delight.

notes:
{小屋|こや} is a small building or shelter.

TYPES OF SMALL BUILDINGS:
- {山|やま}{小屋|ごや} (mountain hut)
- {物置|ものおき}{小屋|こや} (storage shed)
- {犬|いぬ}{小屋|ごや} (doghouse)
- {鶏|にわとり}{小屋|ごや} (chicken coop)
- {掘|ほ}っ{立|た}て{小屋|ごや} (shack, shanty)

NOTE ON READING:
- Standalone: こや
- In compounds: often ごや (rendaku)

HISTORICAL USE:
- {芝居|しばい}{小屋|ごや} (theater, playhouse - historical)
- {見世物|みせもの}{小屋|ごや} (sideshow tent - historical)
